title: I waenganui i te Ao me te Rangi
intro: Kei te tatari mai tētahi wairua ngaro ki a koe i roto i ngā whārangi tapu o te hītori atua, e mau ana i ngā tohu me ngā merekara e tangi tonu ana i roto i ngā tau. I a koe e whai ana i te ara o ngā tohu, ka haere koe i roto i tētahi kōrero kua tohua ki ngā merekara - mai i tētahi tīmatanga merekara ki tētahi pikinga ki tua atu o te rangi. Ka taea e koe te tautuhi i tēnei pononga manaaki i mua i te tohu whakamutunga?
clues: I tonoa ahau hei karere ki ngā tamariki a Iharaira me te kawe i ngā rongo o te aroha me te māramatanga.
He tohu merekara tōku whānautanga — i haere mai ahau ki tēnei ao, kāore he matua, nā te whakahau a te Kaha Rawa.
I ahau e tamariki ana, i kōrero ahau, e tiaki ana i te honore o tōku whaea i ngā whakapae a tōna iwi.
Nā te whakaaetanga a Allah, i hanga e ahau ngā manu i te paru, ā, i whakahaea e ahau te ora ki roto i a rātou — ā, rere atu ana rātou i mua i ngā kanohi o te hunga e mātakitaki ana.
I whakaorangia e au te hunga i whānau matapo, i whakaorangia te repera, ā, i whakaarahia anō hoki te hunga mate - heoi nā Allah ia merekara i hanga, ehara i te mea nāku ake.
I te wā i whakatakoto whakaaro ai ōku hoariri ki te whakangaro i ahau, ka whakaarahia ahau e Allah ki te rangi, ā, ka oati mai ka hoki mai ahau i mua i te Rā Whakawa.

arabic: إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا عَبْدٌ أَنْعَمْنَا عَلَيْهِ وَجَعَلْنَـٰهُ مَثَلًۭا لِّبَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ
verse: He [i.e., Jesus] was not but a servant upon whom We bestowed favor, and We made him an example for the Children of Israel. (43:59)
